Quick rules summary: Ask any yes/no question, and I can only answer with one of these seven responses:

  1. Yes
  2. No
  3. Yes and No
  4. Irrelevant
  5. I don't Know
  6. Define what you mean by...
  7. Rephrase Your Question

 

The Case - Easy

Wayne lies dead in the water, wearing a plastic raincoat.

 

The Mystery

Who killed Wayne, how, and why? How did his murderer get caught?
